title: Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces: Bed Class Coverage Criteria Matrix
content:
Every Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces order is placed in one of six bed classes. For each class the intake team works from five fixed values: the HCPCS code of the bed class, the code actually billed to coverage for the class, how coverage treats the class (covered, or upgrade only), the coverage criteria set for the class, and the patient weight range — the lowest patient weight for which the class is appropriate and the highest patient weight the class is rated for, both in pounds.

## Criteria matrix

| Bed class | HCPCS code of the class | Code billed to coverage | How coverage treats the class | Coverage criteria set | Lowest patient weight (lb) | Highest patient weight (lb) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fixed-Height Hospital Bed (E0250) | E0250 | E0250 | covered | positioning or elevation | 0 | 350 |
| Variable-Height Hospital Bed (E0255) | E0255 | E0255 | covered | height for transfer | 0 | 350 |
| Semi-Electric Hospital Bed (E0260) | E0260 | E0260 | covered | frequent position change | 0 | 350 |
| Total Electric Hospital Bed (E0265) | E0265 | E0260 | upgrade only | electric height convenience | 0 | 350 |
| Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0303) | E0303 | E0303 | covered | weight 350 to 600 | 350 | 600 |
| Extra Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0304) | E0304 | E0304 | covered | weight over 600 | 600 | 1000 |

## Need described for each class

| Bed class | Need the class answers | Weight range stated with the need (lb) |
|---|---|---|
| Fixed-Height Hospital Bed (E0250) | positioning not feasible in an ordinary bed, or head elevation above 30 degrees most of the time, or traction | up to 350 |
| Variable-Height Hospital Bed (E0255) | fixed-height criteria plus a bed height different from a fixed-height bed to transfer | up to 350 |
| Semi-Electric Hospital Bed (E0260) | fixed-height criteria plus frequent or immediate position changes | up to 350 |
| Total Electric Hospital Bed (E0265) | semi-electric criteria; electric height adjustment is a convenience the patient pays for | up to 350 |
| Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0303) | fixed-height criteria | from 350 up to 600 |
| Extra Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0304) | fixed-height criteria | from 600 up to 1000 |

## Reading the matrix

- **Billed code differs from the class code in one row only.** The Total Electric Hospital Bed (E0265) is coded E0265 but the code actually billed to coverage for that class is E0260, and coverage treats the class as upgrade only. For the other five classes the billed code is the class's own code and coverage treats the class as covered.
- **The weight columns are the class's rated range.** The E0250, E0255, E0260 and E0265 classes share the range 0 to 350 pounds; the Heavy-Duty class runs from 350 to 600 pounds and the Extra Heavy-Duty class from 600 to 1000 pounds.

### Hypothetical look-ups (example inputs only)

- A patient recorded at a hypothetical 480 pounds falls inside the Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0303) range of 350 to 600 pounds and outside the 0 to 350 range of the four lighter classes and the 600 to 1000 range of the Extra Heavy-Duty class.
- A patient recorded at a hypothetical 720 pounds falls inside only the Extra Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0304) range of 600 to 1000 pounds.
- A hypothetical order for the Total Electric Hospital Bed (E0265) reads, in the matrix, as billed to coverage under code E0260 with coverage treating the class as upgrade only.
